newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed, volatile session expected.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed, volatile session expected.

text.p: British shares opened mixed on Friday as the dust cleared after the previous day's tumble by global equity markets and dealers said a nervous day was in store with interest rate concerns continuing to dominate.
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares opened 2.5 points higher at 4,260.6 and extended its gains in early trade, reaching 4,270.1 by 0842 GMT, an advance of 12.0 points.
But the FTSE 250 index of mid-cap shares fared less well. It was 2.1 points lower at 4,563.1.
Dealers said a recovery in bond markets was underpinning shares and providing support to the FTSE.
